categories.main_business_segments: KOHSOKU CORPORATION operates a single business segment focused on the manufacturing and sales of packaging materials, primarily for food and industrial applications. The group consists of the parent company and five consolidated subsidiaries, each specializing in areas such as printed paper containers, labels, tea packaging, logistics materials, synthetic resin products, and corrugated cardboard products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages expertise in the design, manufacturing, and distribution of a wide range of packaging materials, including printed paper containers, labels, synthetic resin products, and corrugated cardboard. Production methods include both in-house manufacturing and procurement from a diverse supplier base, with a focus on quality control, efficient logistics, and the ability to customize products (e.g., name printing) to meet customer needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: KOHSOKU serves a broad spectrum of customers, primarily in the food industry (including supermarkets, food processors, and food service providers), as well as industrial sectors requiring packaging solutions. The company does not rely heavily on any single customer or industry, and its products are considered essential for daily life and the expanding ready-to-eat food market.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in Japan, with a nationwide network of 77 sales offices and distribution centers covering all major regions, including Tohoku, Kanto, Kansai, Chubu, Shikoku, and Hokkaido. There are no overseas sales or foreign subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: KOHSOKU primarily functions as a midstream player, acting as a wholesaler and distributor of packaging materials. It also engages in some upstream activities through its manufacturing subsidiaries, but its core role is as an intermediary between packaging material manufacturers and end-user businesses.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include nationwide expansion through new office openings and M&A, enhancing customer satisfaction, developing new products and businesses, promoting digital transformation (DX) for operational efficiency, and advancing ESG initiatives such as CO2 reduction and diversity. The company emphasizes continuous growth, group synergy, and innovation in packaging solutions, although it does not conduct traditional R&D activities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of packaging materials and related products to business customers. The company recognizes revenue at the point of delivery or acceptance, and also engages in some manufacturing for custom and branded packaging solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KOHSOKU is a leading packaging materials wholesaler in Japan, with a strong nationwide presence and a diversified product lineup. The industry is competitive, with risks from both upstream manufacturers entering wholesale and new entrants, but KOHSOKU differentiates itself through its broad product range, logistics expertise, and ability to provide comprehensive solutions. Major competitors are other large packaging wholesalers and specialized packaging manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2025, KOHSOKU reported consolidated net sales of approximately 115.9 billion yen and net income attributable to parent shareholders of 3.47 billion yen, both marking record highs. The company has achieved ten consecutive years of record sales and sustained profit growth, with a workforce of over 1,100 employees (excluding temporary staff). The balance sheet is robust, with a high equity ratio (64.9%) and no interest-bearing debt.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KOHSOKU emphasizes its ability to provide a one-stop solution for a wide variety of packaging needs, offering a comprehensive product lineup, reliable and timely delivery, and customized design services. The company highlights its expertise in logistics, its broad supplier network, and its commitment to environmental and social responsibility as key differentiators, aiming to be an indispensable partner for customers in the food and industrial sectors.
